projects.title: WorldExplorer
projects.description: An educational and interactive platform for exploring countries, cultures, languages, writing systems, and landmarks from around the world. Discover fascinating traditions, historical events, national symbols, and geographical wonders.

projects.title: ThreatLens
projects.description: A lightweight network intrusion detection system for LAN environments, combining a Django web dashboard with an ML-based detection engine — covering real-time packet capture, feature extraction, model inference, rule generation, and IPS integration.

projects.title: byteplay
projects.description: A multi-platform network packet analyzer and replayer that lets you capture, edit, and replay raw TCP/UDP packets to test server resilience — with byte-level hex diffing, going beyond passive tools like Wireshark or application-layer tools like Burp Suite and Postman.

projects.title: Contract Lifecycle Management Platform
projects.description: An enterprise-grade, AI-augmented contract management system covering the full lifecycle of commercial agreements — centralized repository with version control, a clause library and template engine, configurable multi-stage approval workflows, LLM-driven contract intelligence.

projects.title: OptiTest — Split Testing Suite
projects.description: A frequentist A/B testing analysis tool: takes visitor and conversion counts for control and treatment groups and runs a two-proportion z-test, confidence interval on lift, effect size (Cohen's h), power analysis with required sample size, and a plain-English decision recommendation, exportable as Markdown/JSON reports via a Streamlit dashboard or Python API.

projects.title: LFA Platform — Logical Framework Design for Education NGOs
projects.description: A web platform helping education NGOs design programs using the Common Logical Framework Approach, guiding users through a 7-step wizard across 9 themes with ready-made templates, PDF export, auto-save, authentication, an analytics dashboard, and offline-first PWA support.

projects.title: Flint
projects.description: A transpilation-oriented DSL compiler toolchain with an embedded REPL runtime, built on a custom lexer-parser-semantic pipeline: tokenization, recursive-descent AST parsing, semantic validation, and tree-walking execution, supporting closures, higher-order functions, and structural typing, with both an interactive Rich-based REPL and batch file execution.

projects.title: Glue — MLOps Project
projects.description: A production-grade ML system for predicting customer churn with a full MLOps lifecycle: leakage-safe feature engineering, a LightGBM model with MLflow experiment tracking, SHAP explanations, FastAPI serving (real-time + batch), PSI/KS drift detection, Airflow-orchestrated retraining, and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

projects.title: route
projects.description: An interactive API learning platform covering REST, GraphQL, SOAP, gRPC, and WebSockets across 12 hands-on modules — auth, CRUD, file uploads, webhooks, WebSocket chat, versioning, and more — with live in-browser testing, auto-generated docs, and zero external services or API keys required. The backend is built with FastAPI and the frontend with React.

projects.title: Delta — Satellite Change Detection
projects.description: A Siamese U-Net model for detecting urban change from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, trained on the OSCD100 dataset and applied to a real-world case study of urban development in Patna, India — producing binary change masks from before/after image pairs.

projects.title: Ageis
projects.description: A secrets management system where the server never has access to plaintext credentials or decryption keys — all encryption and decryption happens client-side using envelope encryption, X25519 key wrapping for multi-party access, and Argon2id key derivation.
